system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:24 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 was the source workstation for a network logon to WS-MLOPEZ-01 using maria.lopez's account.

At 13:41 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 was the source workstation for a network logon to WS-OHADDAD-01 using omar.haddad's account. The inventory identifies omar.haddad as the sole IT administrator and says remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01, making this source/destination pattern inconsistent with that practice.

At 14:10 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 connected through the proxy to update.chartmate-imaging.net, and the connection was attributed to cmupdate.exe running from the user's AppData\Local\ChartMate directory. The inventory instead lists update.chartmate-imaging.com and a cmupdate.exe path under Program Files; the observed hostname and executable path do not match those listed details.

Dropbox.exe was launched by ben.carter from Explorer at 14:14 UTC. The inventory says no file-sharing or cloud-storage services other than approved services are authorized; the available records do not establish whether Dropbox transferred files.

A file named installer-70930.exe was created in ben.carter's Downloads folder at 14:18 UTC. The record attributes the creation event to RuntimeBroker.exe but does not identify the file's source or show that it was executed.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-BCARTER-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alert interval.
Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so the proxy records do not provide a complete destination history for the alert interval.
Zeek connection records show connections from WS-BCARTER-01 to the proxy, but the supplied records do not identify the external destinations for those connections during the collection gap.
claims_not_established: The available records do not establish that the periodic connections during the alert interval were all to the observed ChartMate-looking hostname, or identify their destinations throughout that interval.
The records do not establish whether Dropbox was used to upload or download data.
The records do not establish the source, contents, or execution of installer-70930.exe.
The records do not establish how maria.lopez's or omar.haddad's credentials were obtained, or whether the observed account use was authorized.
additional_evidence_needed: Restore or retrieve proxy logs for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT destinations, user agents, byte counts, and timestamps.
Retrieve endpoint process, network, authentication, and file telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 covering the collection outage.
Validate the observed ChartMate hostname and AppData executable against approved vendor information; preserve and inspect the executable and its signature.
Determine whether Dropbox transferred data and identify the source and execution status of installer-70930.exe.
Confirm with the account owners and IT whether the maria.lopez and omar.haddad logons were expected, and review related authentication and access activity on the target workstations.
